caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright bottle with a cylindrical shape that tapers gradually toward a short, narrow neck and a slightly pronounced, rounded lip at the top. The body of the bottle is long and smooth with a subtle vertical curvature, and the base is rounded. The color of the bottle is light brown with variations in tonality, showing some slightly darker and lighter patches that suggest the texture and natural shading of the material. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, bordered with a simple rectangular outline that frames the bottle centrally. There is handwritten text below the drawing, indicating the scale ("SCALE EXACT SIZE") and the artist’s name ("FRANK MAHER").
title: Stone Bottle
